about_the_game:
Do you have what it takes to hide in plain sight or hunt down the hidden? PROPTOP is an intense multiplayer hide-and-seek game where players transform into everyday objects to evade hunters or track down disguised props!

🔥 Key Features:
✅ Thrilling Hide & Seek Gameplay – Disguise yourself as a prop or take on the role of a hunter in fast-paced, strategic matches.
✅ Dynamic Maps – Explore a variety of unique environments designed for maximum hiding and hunting fun.
✅ Deceptive Disguises – Blend in with your surroundings by mimicking objects and outsmarting your pursuers.
✅ Exciting Abilities & Power-Ups – Use special skills to escape, mislead, or track down opponents.
✅ Multiplayer Madness – Play with friends or challenge players worldwide in action-packed matches.

Will you be the ultimate hider, the relentless hunter, or the mastermind who outplays them all? Join the game now and test your skills!

🔫 Hunt. Hide. Survive. 🎭
